other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Sanitary ceramics industry with kiln firing identified as the dominant energy hotspot
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
The largest energy consumption was during the 
firing process in the kiln. Thus, the firing process was determined as a hotspot of energy consumption.

other_continuous_flow_signals.signal: Study applies energy-baseline regression to the ceramic sanitary production sector's energy consumption
other_continuous_flow_signals.quote:
In the sanitary ceramics sector which the production system (covering 5 processes) consumes energy more than 
the other systems, this production system that uses energy the most is firing process which consumes thermal energy 
or electrical energy a lot.

one_line: Applies multiple linear regression and energy-baseline analysis to measured energy data of Thailand's sanitary ceramics (ceramic sanitary ware) factories to build an Energy Utilization Index; ceramics is not among the eight Corpus-B sectors and the described process is discrete product manufacturing, not continuous glass flow.
